checklist.step: Pull the current-cycle OSFI climate disclosure survey template
actions: Log in to OSFI's Regulatory Reporting System (RRS) and download the current-year climate risk disclosure survey template.
Compare the template to last year's version and note any new or changed metric, threshold, or section.
Brief the data-collection owners on any changes before collection begins.
Log the template version and download date on the survey tracker.
checklist.done: the current survey template is downloaded, compared to the prior version for changes, and data owners are briefed.

checklist.step: Compile the governance section evidence
actions: Pull board and committee minutes from the board portal evidencing climate risk oversight discussions in the fiscal year.
Document the board's role in setting the climate risk appetite and reviewing climate strategy.
Document management's climate governance structure (committee, reporting lines) as of fiscal year-end.
Attach the minute excerpts as supporting evidence for the governance section.
checklist.done: governance section evidence, including board minute excerpts and the management structure description, is compiled and attached.

checklist.step: Compile the strategy section evidence
actions: Document the climate-related risks and opportunities identified as material to the business over short, medium and long time horizons.
Summarize any climate scenario analysis performed (see the ORSA climate scenario integration control) and its strategic implications.
Describe the resilience of the business strategy under the scenarios considered.
Route the draft to the Chief Strategy Officer for review.
checklist.done: the strategy section is drafted with material risks, scenario implications and strategy resilience described, and reviewed by the Chief Strategy Officer.

checklist.step: Compile the risk management section evidence
actions: Pull the climate risk identification, assessment and monitoring process documentation from the GRC platform.
Document how climate risk is integrated into the overall enterprise risk management framework and risk appetite statement.
Document any climate-specific risk limits, triggers or escalation protocols in place during the fiscal year.
Attach the GRC platform extracts as supporting evidence.
checklist.done: the risk management section is compiled with GRC platform evidence attached showing climate risk integration into the ERM framework.

checklist.step: Collect the quantitative metrics and targets data
actions: Pull financed/insured emissions or exposure metrics required by the survey from the enterprise data warehouse and from external climate data providers under contract.
Reconcile each metric's underlying exposure or portfolio total to the general ledger or the investment/underwriting system of record.
Document data source, calculation methodology and any known limitation for each metric.
Flag any metric the organization cannot yet calculate and document the stated reason (data unavailability, methodology not yet developed).
checklist.done: quantitative metrics are collected, reconciled to source systems, documented with methodology, and any gap is flagged with a stated reason.

checklist.step: Review third-party data provider terms for climate data use
actions: Confirm the contract with each external climate/emissions data provider permits use of the data in a regulatory disclosure.
Confirm the provider's data lineage and update frequency meet the survey's currency requirement.
Document any contractual limitation on data use or redistribution.
Flag any provider relationship needing a contract amendment before next year's cycle.
checklist.done: third-party data provider terms are confirmed to permit regulatory use, with any limitation documented and any needed amendment flagged.

checklist.step: Assemble the complete survey response
actions: Enter the governance, strategy, risk management and metrics/targets section content into the OSFI survey template.
Cross-check every quantitative figure against its source reconciliation from the data collection step.
Confirm every narrative section addresses the specific sub-questions in the template, not a generic restatement.
Save the assembled draft with a version tag.
checklist.done: the complete survey draft is assembled, every figure is cross-checked to its source, and every sub-question is addressed.

checklist.step: Obtain Enterprise Risk Manager and Sustainability review
actions: Review the assembled draft for consistency with the entity's ORSA and enterprise risk management framework.
Confirm the metrics and targets reported are consistent with any internal or external climate commitments already made.
Return comments to the Sustainability Risk Manager with a fixed turnaround.
Approve the draft for legal review.
checklist.done: the Chief Risk Officer has reviewed the draft for consistency and approved it for legal review.

checklist.step: Route the draft through Regulatory Counsel review
actions: Read the draft survey for language that overstates certainty in metrics flagged as limited or estimated.
Confirm any forward-looking target statement includes appropriate qualification.
Return comments to the Sustainability Risk Manager.
Sign off that the survey language is regulator-ready.
checklist.done: Regulatory Counsel has signed off that the survey language is appropriately qualified and regulator-ready.

checklist.step: Obtain Chief Risk Officer sign-off to submit
actions: Review the legally cleared final draft.
Provide written sign-off authorizing submission.
Log the sign-off date on the survey tracker.
Notify the Regulatory Reporting Analyst to proceed with submission.
checklist.done: the Chief Risk Officer has signed off in writing to authorize submission.

checklist.step: Submit the survey via OSFI's Regulatory Reporting System
actions: Log in to RRS and open the climate risk disclosure survey filing shell for the correct entity and fiscal year.
Enter or upload the approved survey content into the prescribed schedule.
Run RRS validation edits and resolve any flagged issue.
Submit the survey and capture the confirmation number and timestamp.
checklist.done: the survey is submitted in RRS with validation edits cleared and a confirmation number captured.

checklist.step: Distribute the submission confirmation internally
actions: Send the RRS confirmation to the Chief Risk Officer, Chief Strategy Officer and Board Governance Lead.
Update the survey tracker status to 'Submitted' with the confirmation number and date.
Add the submission to the next Compliance Committee update.
checklist.done: the submission confirmation is distributed and the survey tracker is updated to 'Submitted'.

checklist.step: Handle any OSFI clarification query on the survey
actions: Monitor the RRS message center for OSFI clarification queries on the submitted survey.
Route any methodology question to the Data Analyst and any governance question to the Board Governance Lead.
Have Regulatory Counsel review any substantive response before submission.
Log the query and response on the survey tracker.
checklist.done: every OSFI clarification query is logged, routed, reviewed by Regulatory Counsel where substantive, and answered.

checklist.step: Archive the survey package
actions: Assemble the final submitted survey, source metric reconciliations, provider terms review and sign-offs into a package.
Upload the package to the compliance evidence repository under the fiscal year and legal entity.
Apply the 7-year retention label.
Confirm the package is indexed and searchable by fiscal year.
checklist.done: the survey package is archived, retention-labelled and indexed by fiscal year and entity.

checklist.step: Set the next cycle's climate survey calendar and reminders
actions: Load next year's survey submission window into the survey tracker once OSFI publishes it.
Configure reminders at T-90 (kickoff), T-45 (draft complete) and T-15 (sign-off) days before the deadline.
Confirm the reminder distribution list is current after any personnel change.
checklist.done: next cycle's survey deadline is calendared with T-90/T-45/T-15 reminders configured to the current owner list.

testing.step: Build the population of climate survey submissions in the review period
actions: Extract from OSFI's RRS filing history every climate risk disclosure survey submission in the period, by legal entity.
Reconcile the count to the required filing entity list.
Resolve any missing entity before sampling.
testing.done: the population reconciles to the required filing entity list and is signed as complete.

testing.step: Reconcile each submission to Chief Risk Officer sign-off
actions: Match each submission to a written Chief Risk Officer sign-off.
Check the sign-off date pre-dates the RRS submission timestamp.
List unmatched submissions as automatic exceptions.
testing.done: every submission is matched to a pre-dated Chief Risk Officer sign-off or listed as an exception.

testing.step: Select the sample and document the selection method
actions: Take 100% of submissions given the annual, low-volume population across entities.
Record the population size and test date in the workpaper.
testing.done: 100% of the submission population is included with the population size documented.

testing.step: Trace every quantitative metric to its source reconciliation
actions: For each sampled submission, pull the source reconciliation workpaper for every quantitative metric reported.
Independently recompute at least 5 metrics from the enterprise data warehouse or provider extract.
Compare recomputed figures to the submitted figures and log any variance beyond tolerance.
Confirm every metric with a stated limitation is documented as such in the submission.
testing.done: quantitative metrics are independently recomputed and traced to source for every sampled submission, with variances logged.

testing.step: Verify the governance section against board minutes
actions: Pull board and committee minutes from the board portal for the fiscal year covered by the submission.
Confirm the governance section's description of board oversight is supported by the actual minutes.
Log any unsupported governance claim as an exception.
testing.done: the governance section is confirmed supported by actual board minutes or the gap is logged.

testing.step: Verify third-party data provider terms were confirmed
actions: Confirm a documented contract review exists for each external data provider whose data was used in the sampled submission.
Confirm the review pre-dates the submission date.
Log any missing or post-dated contract review as an exception.
testing.done: third-party data provider terms review is confirmed present and pre-dated for every sampled submission, or logged as an exception.

testing.step: Confirm Regulatory Counsel review occurred
actions: Confirm a signed Regulatory Counsel review exists for each sampled submission.
Confirm the review pre-dates the Chief Risk Officer sign-off.
Log any missing or out-of-sequence review as an exception.
testing.done: Regulatory Counsel review is confirmed present and correctly sequenced for every sampled submission, or logged as an exception.

testing.step: Recompute submission timeliness against the OSFI survey deadline
actions: Pull the OSFI-published submission deadline for the survey cycle.
Compare to the actual RRS submission timestamp for each sampled entity.
Log any late submission as a reportable exception.
testing.done: submission timeliness is recomputed and compared to the published deadline for every sampled entity.

testing.step: Log every exception with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a tracker issue per exception with the entity, metric or section affected, and the compliance impact.
Assign a root cause (data gap, unreviewed provider contract, missed sign-off, late submission) and an owner.
Set a remediation date and, for a missed statutory-style deadline, notify Regulatory Counsel.
Carry every open exception into next year's test as a mandatory retest row.
testing.done: every exception has an issue, a root cause, an owner, a remediation date and a retest commitment.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the test
actions: Compute the exception rate against the zero-tolerance threshold for untraceable metrics or late submission.
Write the conclusion (effective / effective with exceptions / ineffective) with evidence references.
Have the independent reviewer, who compiled none of the sampled submissions, sign the workpaper.
Report results to the Risk Committee and file the workpaper in the evidence repository.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion, exception rate and committee reporting date exists in the repository.

checklist.step: Confirm the material lines of business requiring climate scenario coverage
actions: Pull the current materiality assessment from the GRC platform, ranking lines of business by exposure to physical and transition climate risk.
Confirm coverage of property lines exposed to physical perils, and long-tail liability, energy and real-estate-linked investment portfolios exposed to transition risk.
Flag any newly material line not covered in the prior year's scenario set.
Route the confirmed coverage list to the Chief Risk Officer for approval.
checklist.done: the material lines requiring climate scenario coverage are confirmed, any newly material line is flagged, and the list is approved.

checklist.step: Select the physical and transition risk scenario pathways
actions: Select physical risk scenarios (e.g., increased frequency/severity of weather perils) aligned to recognized pathways such as the NGFS scenario framework.
Select transition risk scenarios (e.g., orderly, disorderly and hot-house-world pathways) covering carbon-pricing, policy and technology shifts.
Document the rationale for each pathway selected and its relevance to the entity's material lines of business.
Route the selected scenario set to the Chief Risk Officer and Appointed Actuary for approval.
checklist.done: physical and transition scenario pathways are selected, documented with rationale, and approved.

checklist.step: Translate scenarios into modelable risk drivers
actions: For physical risk scenarios, translate the selected pathway into peril frequency/severity shifts using the catastrophe modeling data provider's climate-conditioned output.
For transition risk scenarios, translate carbon-price and policy pathways into asset repricing and underwriting exposure shifts with the Investment Analyst.
Document the translation methodology and any third-party model relied on.
Hand the risk-driver set to the Reserving Actuary/Reinsurance Actuary for cash-flow modeling.
checklist.done: each scenario pathway is translated into modelable risk drivers with methodology and data source documented.

checklist.step: Model the financial impact of each scenario
actions: Load the translated risk drivers into the actuarial/ALM projection model alongside the base ORSA/FCT scenario set.
Run each climate scenario over the ORSA's multi-year projection horizon, capturing surplus, capital ratio and liquidity impacts.
Compare results to the base scenario to isolate the incremental climate impact.
Save each run log to the model governance repository with scenario name and version.
checklist.done: each climate scenario's financial impact is modeled over the ORSA horizon, isolated from the base scenario, and logged.

checklist.step: Assess capital and liquidity adequacy under each climate scenario
actions: Compare the projected capital ratio under each climate scenario to the internal target and OSFI supervisory target.
Identify the projection year and magnitude of any capital or liquidity shortfall.
Document plausible management actions consistent with the entity's risk appetite that would address a projected shortfall.
Summarize results by scenario in a capital adequacy table.
checklist.done: capital and liquidity adequacy under every climate scenario is assessed, with any shortfall and its management action documented.

checklist.step: Link scenario results to the risk appetite statement
actions: Compare the scenario results to the climate risk appetite thresholds recorded in the GRC platform.
Identify any threshold breach under a plausible scenario and document the required escalation.
Update the risk appetite statement's climate section if a threshold proves miscalibrated against the scenario results.
Record the linkage analysis in the ORSA workpaper.
checklist.done: scenario results are compared to the climate risk appetite with any breach escalated and documented in the ORSA workpaper.

checklist.step: Draft the ORSA climate scenario section
actions: Draft the ORSA report section covering scenario selection rationale, modeled financial impacts, capital/liquidity adequacy results and risk appetite linkage.
Cite the OSFI Guideline B-15 and E-19 provisions the section responds to.
Attach the run logs and capital adequacy table as exhibits.
Route the drafted section to the Appointed Actuary for consistency review against the FCT report.
checklist.done: the ORSA climate scenario section is drafted with exhibits attached and routed for consistency review.

checklist.step: Reconcile the climate scenario section to the FCT report
actions: Compare the climate scenario assumptions and capital impacts to the corresponding FCT report scenarios.
Confirm no inconsistency exists between the two reports' conclusions on capital adequacy.
Resolve and document any inconsistency before the ORSA section is finalized.
Sign off that the two reports are consistent.
checklist.done: the ORSA climate section and the FCT report are confirmed consistent, with any resolved inconsistency documented and signed off.

checklist.step: Obtain independent peer review of the scenario modeling
actions: Independently re-run at least one physical and one transition risk scenario in a parallel model instance.
Compare results to the reported figures and log any variance beyond tolerance as a review finding.
Confirm the translation methodology from scenario pathway to risk driver is documented and reproducible.
Sign and date the peer review checklist.
checklist.done: a peer reviewer has independently reproduced at least one physical and one transition scenario within tolerance and signed off.

checklist.step: Present the climate scenario results to the Board Risk Committee
actions: Upload the ORSA climate scenario section and capital adequacy table to the board portal ahead of the Risk Committee meeting.
Have the Chief Risk Officer present the scenario results, any risk appetite breach and the proposed management actions.
Record committee questions, responses and any requested follow-up in the minutes.
File the minute extract with the ORSA record.
checklist.done: the climate scenario results are presented to and received by the Board Risk Committee with minutes filed against the ORSA record.

checklist.step: Finalize the ORSA report with the climate section incorporated
actions: Incorporate any board feedback into the final ORSA climate scenario section.
Confirm the full ORSA report, including the climate section, is internally consistent and complete.
Sign off on the final ORSA report for submission.
Log the sign-off date on the ORSA tracker.
checklist.done: the ORSA report with the climate scenario section incorporated is signed off as final.

checklist.step: Submit the ORSA Key Metrics Report reflecting the climate scenario results
actions: Log in to OSFI's RRS and open the ORSA Key Metrics Report (KMR) filing shell for the entity and fiscal year.
Enter the climate-scenario-informed capital and risk metrics into the prescribed KMR fields.
Run RRS validation edits and resolve any flagged inconsistency.
Submit the KMR and retain the confirmation number and timestamp.
checklist.done: the KMR reflecting the climate scenario results is submitted in RRS with validation edits cleared and confirmation retained.

checklist.step: Update the model governance and scenario change log
actions: Record the climate scenario pathways, translation methodology version and model version used in the model governance repository.
Tag each change with the approver and date.
Cross-reference the ORSA report exhibit number.
Flag any change requiring further model risk validation before next use.
checklist.done: every climate scenario model/methodology change is logged, tagged, cross-referenced and flagged for validation where required.

checklist.step: Archive the ORSA climate scenario package
actions: Assemble the scenario selection rationale, translation methodology, run logs, capital adequacy table, peer review checklist and board minutes into one package.
Upload the package to the compliance evidence repository under the fiscal year and legal entity.
Apply the 7-year retention label.
Confirm the package is indexed and searchable by fiscal year and entity.
checklist.done: the complete ORSA climate scenario package is archived, retention-labelled and indexed by fiscal year and entity.

checklist.step: Set the next cycle's ORSA climate scenario calendar and reminders
actions: Load next year's ORSA submission window into the ORSA tracker with milestone dates for scenario selection, modeling and board presentation.
Configure reminders at T-100 (selection), T-60 (modeling complete) and T-30 (board presentation) days before the ORSA submission deadline.
Confirm the reminder distribution list is current after any personnel change.
checklist.done: next cycle's ORSA climate scenario milestones are calendared with reminders configured to the current owner list.

testing.step: Build the population of climate scenarios incorporated into the review period's ORSA
actions: Extract from the model governance repository every climate scenario run incorporated into the ORSA/FCT program in the review period, by legal entity.
Reconcile the count to the material lines of business list approved for coverage.
Resolve any uncovered material line before sampling.
testing.done: the population reconciles to the approved material-lines coverage list and is signed as complete.

testing.step: Reconcile the ORSA climate section to the FCT report
actions: Compare the climate scenario assumptions and capital conclusions in the filed ORSA report to the FCT report for the same period.
Confirm the Appointed Actuary's consistency sign-off exists and pre-dates ORSA finalization.
List any unreconciled inconsistency as an exception.
testing.done: the ORSA climate section is confirmed consistent with the FCT report and the sign-off is pre-dated, or the gap is logged.

testing.step: Select the sample and document the selection method
actions: Take 100% of physical-risk and transition-risk scenario pathways used in the ORSA.
Take one additional material line of business at random for a full re-performance.
Record the seed, population size and selection date in the workpaper.
testing.done: the sample covers 100% of scenario pathways plus a reproducible additional material-line re-performance.

testing.step: Re-perform the scenario-to-risk-driver translation
actions: Independently pull the catastrophe data provider's current climate-conditioned output for the sampled physical scenario.
Recompute the peril frequency/severity shift and compare to the recorded risk driver.
Log any variance beyond tolerance as an exception.
testing.done: the scenario-to-risk-driver translation is independently recomputed for the sampled scenario, with variance logged.

testing.step: Re-perform the financial impact modeling for the sample
actions: Reload the sampled scenario's risk drivers into a parallel model instance.
Re-execute the financial impact projection independently of the production run.
Compare the re-performed capital/liquidity impact to the reported figures and log any variance beyond tolerance.
Capture the re-performed run log into the test workpaper.
testing.done: the financial impact is independently re-performed for the sampled scenario with the variance documented.

testing.step: Verify the risk appetite linkage analysis
actions: Pull the climate risk appetite thresholds from the GRC platform as of the ORSA reporting date.
Compare the sampled scenario's results to those thresholds independently.
Confirm any breach identified was escalated per the documented process.
Log any unescalated breach as an exception.
testing.done: risk appetite linkage is independently verified for the sampled scenario with any unescalated breach logged.

testing.step: Confirm peer review and board presentation evidence exists
actions: Confirm a signed peer review checklist exists for the sampled scenario modeling.
Pull board minutes from the board portal confirming the climate scenario results were presented to the Risk Committee.
Log any missing peer review or board presentation as an exception.
testing.done: peer review and board presentation evidence is confirmed for the sampled scenario or logged as exceptions.

testing.step: Trace the ORSA KMR submission to the underlying scenario results
actions: Open the filed ORSA Key Metrics Report in RRS and locate the climate-scenario-informed metrics.
Compare the filed figures to the capital adequacy table in the ORSA workpaper.
Log any mismatch as an exception.
testing.done: the filed KMR climate metrics are confirmed to tie to the ORSA workpaper's capital adequacy table, or the mismatch is logged.

testing.step: Log every exception with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise a tracker issue per exception with the scenario, entity, what was missed and the capital/compliance impact.
Assign a root cause (uncovered material line, translation error, modeling variance, missed escalation) and an owner.
Set a remediation date and, for capital-adequacy exceptions, notify the Appointed Actuary and Chief Financial Officer.
Carry every open exception into next year's test as a mandatory retest row.
testing.done: every exception has an issue, a root cause, an owner, a remediation date and a retest commitment.

testing.step: Conclude, sign and report the test
actions: Compute the exception rate against the zero-tolerance threshold for missing scenario pathway coverage.
Write the conclusion (effective / effective with exceptions / ineffective) with evidence references.
Have the independent reviewer, who selected and modeled none of the sampled scenarios, sign the workpaper.
Report results to the Board Risk Committee and file the workpaper in the evidence repository.
testing.done: a signed workpaper with a stated conclusion, exception rate and committee reporting date exists in the repository.
